name: CursorCraft – Cursor Builder for Elementor
author: webbhavan

sections.description:
Tired of boring default cursors? CursorCraft revolutionizes the way users interact with your website. Built exclusively for Elementor, this tool lets you design custom cursors visually using Elementor containers and widgets.

✨ TRY THE LIVE DEMO ✨

CursorCraft – Cursor Builder for Elementor is a powerful, lightweight addon that lets you turn any Elementor Container into a fully functioning custom mouse cursor. Instead of being limited to basic shapes, you can use Elementor’s native drag-and-drop builder to design your cursor exactly how you want it!

🌟 Free Features

  • Container as Cursor: Use Elementor Containers to design anything from simple dots to complex animated widgets, and set them to follow the mouse.
  • Global Cursors: Instantly apply your custom cursor across your entire WordPress website.
  • Smooth Physics: Choose between instant tracking or smooth, spring-like physics with a customizable speed slider.
  • Dynamic Velocity Physics: Organic squash & stretch physics that dynamically elongates the cursor along the angle of motion and squashes perpendicularly based on speed.
  • Interactive Scaling: Automatically scale the cursor up or down when the user hovers over clickable elements (links, buttons, inputs).
  • Dedicated Hover State Cursors: Design an entirely separate Elementor Container that dynamically swaps in when users hover over links and buttons.
  • Interactive Dot Grid Widget: A beautiful, responsive grid of dots that magnetically repel away from your cursor using high-performance canvas physics.
  • Scratch-off Reveal Mask Widget: Create a captivating “scratch-off” effect that reveals a hidden image underneath as the user moves their mouse.
  • Volumetric Smoke Background Widget: An ultra-fluid, colorful smoke simulation that reacts dynamically to the user’s cursor movements.
  • Interactive Portfolio List Widget: A creative-agency style text list that reveals massive, gorgeous floating images that seamlessly follow the cursor behind the text.
  • Custom Text Highlight: Automatically override the browser’s default blue text selection color to perfectly match your custom cursor!
  • Click Shrink Feedback: Add subtle tactile feedback that smoothly shrinks the cursor when you press down on elements.
  • 1-Click Duplicate: Easily duplicate your entire custom cursor and all of its settings with a single click.
  • Advanced Blend Modes: Apply CSS mix-blend-modes (like Difference or Exclusion) so your cursor dynamically reacts to and inverts the background colors behind it.
  • Fully Responsive: Easily hide the custom cursor on tablets and mobile devices to save performance and battery life.

🚀 Pro Features (Unlock Your True Potential)

Take your designs to the absolute limit with CursorCraft Pro.
Upgrade to CursorCraft Pro Here!

  • 3D Card Tilt & Interactive Parallax: Transform any container or card on your website into a 3D tilting card with glossy specular glare reflections and multi-depth parallax.
  • Emoji Particle Trails: Emit multi-emoji particle streams (✨,🔥,💖,⭐,🚀,🌸,💫) with custom physics (float up, gravity fall, scatter drift, spiral) and continuous rotational spin.
  • Custom Text Particle & Follow Trails: Snake individual letters of any custom phrase behind the cursor in an elastic snake chain, or emit sequential text particle streams.
  • Advanced Visual Effects: Unlock jaw-dropping real-time shaders including Liquid Fluid Waves, Electric Aura & Lightning, Starfield Warp Speed, Stardust Glow Particles, Fire & Flame Embers, Cyber Digital Stream, and Swirling Spiral Vortex.
  • Click Animation & Bursts: Trigger exciting dynamic particle bursts and ripple waves whenever users click (Ripple Wave, Confetti Pop, Neon Shockwave, Liquid Splash, Sparkle Burst, Electric Spark).
  • 8 Premium Particle Trails: Ghost Clones, Comet Tail, Magic Stars, Floating Bubbles, Image Sequences, Custom Particles, Emoji Trails, and Text Trails.
  • Spinning Circular Text: Wrap continuous rotating text around your cursor that dynamically tracks movement.
  • Scroll Progress Ring: Wrap an elegant, customizable SVG ring around your cursor that perfectly tracks reading progress as users scroll down the page.
  • Backdrop Invert (Glass Effect): Invert colors behind the cursor like a floating glass magnifying lens.
  • Magnetic Snapping: Automatically pull and snap your cursor to the exact center of buttons and icons for a premium, app-like feel.
  • Custom Hover Text: Write and display your own custom text badges or call-to-action labels (e.g., “VIEW”, “PLAY”, “BUY”, “EXPLORE”) directly inside your cursor.
  • Advanced Display Rules: Build complex logic to only show cursors on WooCommerce products, Custom Post Types, or specific archives.
  • Multiple Display Conditions: Stack and combine multiple display rules on a single cursor for precise, granular control.
  • Pro Starter Templates: Instantly import 12+ ready-to-use pro templates including Cosmic Stardust, Liquid Fluid Waves, Hyperdrive Warp, and Matrix Stream.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP file via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to CursorCraft in your WordPress dashboard menu.
  4. Click Add New Cursor to create a new cursor template.
  5. Set your Display Conditions (e.g. Entire Site or Specific Selector) in the box below the title.
  6. Click Edit with Elementor to visually design your cursor.
  7. Inside the Elementor editor, select your main Container, navigate to the Advanced Tab, and enable the Custom Cursor section to configure your physics and animations.
sections.faq:
Does this slow down my website?

No! The plugin is extremely lightweight and uses GPU-accelerated CSS transforms (translate and scale) alongside requestAnimationFrame for buttery smooth, zero-lag 60fps performance.

How do I hide it on mobile and tablets?

In the Elementor editor, go to Container > Advanced > Custom Cursor > Responsive & Accessibility. You can enable “Hide on Touch Devices” and customize the “Disable Below Screen Size (px)” breakpoint (default: 1024px) to automatically hide the custom cursor on smaller screens and touch devices.

Can I use any Elementor widget inside my custom cursor?

Yes! You can design your cursor using any Elementor widget — icons, images, headings, animated Lottie files, SVGs, or custom text.

How do I target a custom cursor to a specific section or button?

When editing your cursor, select “Specific CSS Selector” under Display Conditions and enter your target class or ID (e.g. .my-button, .portfolio-card, or #hero). The custom cursor will only activate when hovering over those specific elements.

Does CursorCraft require Elementor Pro?

No! CursorCraft works seamlessly with both Elementor Free and Elementor Pro. All core features, physics, and included interactive widgets work directly with the free version of Elementor.

Can I create a cursor that changes when hovering over links or buttons?

Yes! You can enable “Enable Hover States” to automatically scale the cursor on interactive elements, or design a dedicated Hover State cursor container that dynamically swaps in on hover.

How do I exclude specific elements from triggering the custom cursor?

In the Elementor editor under Container > Advanced > Custom Cursor, enter comma-separated CSS selectors (e.g. .no-cursor, .my-modal, iframe) into the “Exclude Selectors” field. On these elements, the custom cursor will automatically hide.
